name: Shifting Weakness
body:
You can manipulate the biology of your symbiote to render it less vulnerable to harm.

Prerequisite: Symbiotic slayer 5th.

Benefit(s): Once per week, you can spend 8 hours to change your symbiote’s vulnerability to another energy type.

Normal: You cannot change your symbiote’s vulnerability.
